text: That's a rotten run of luck, {speaker}. Sit by the fire a while.
Sick? Get inside, {speaker}. I'll not have you dying on my floor.
Hard, that. I've had my own share of it {time}.
Come here. You've carried that on your own long enough.
Rough going. Say the word and I'll walk you to the {place}.
Then take my shift at the {place} tomorrow. Rest.
I've {qty} {item} spare. Take them and say no more about it.
Sit. I'll fetch you {need} before you fall over.
Tell me what wants doing and I'll do it, {speaker}.
You'll not manage that alone. I'm coming with you.
Aye, it's been going round. Mind the cold air.
It's a hard season for everyone. The {place} is the same.
That's the way of it lately. Nothing comes easy.
Hm. Bad luck travels in threes, they say.
Hm. Plenty of it about.
That's your business, {speaker}, not mine.
Aye. Well.
I've enough on at the {place} without hearing yours.
Good.
Ha. Hurry up about it, then.
Saves me wishing it on you, {speaker}.
Some things sort themselves out after all.
Sick, is it. And here I was hoping for worse.
Poor {speaker}. However will the hall manage.
You've a gift for it. Everything you touch goes the same way.
That's well earned, {speaker}. Drink on it tonight.
Ha! Good. There's not enough of that going about.
About time somebody had a bit of luck at the {place}.
Well done. You've worked {work} long enough for it.
Aye? That's something, at least.
Good for you. The {place} could use the news.
Mm. You'll tell the whole hall before nightfall.
Is that so.
One seam. Come back when it's a vein.
Luck like that has a way of turning, {speaker}.
A few coins and you're a lord of the {place} now, are you.
Enjoy it. It'll not last the week.
Then go early and take a light. The {place} eats the careless.
Take {qty} {item} with you. You'll want them before the day's out.
Do it, but not alone. Nothing good comes of going alone.
Aye, well. Mind how you go.
That's your day settled, then.
Your business. Do as you like.
You said that last week too.
Don't. Not with what's been coming up out of the {place}.
Aye. You've an eye, {speaker}. It's {injury}, mostly.
You're not wrong. I've been poor company {time}.
It shows, does it. Aye.
It's {injury}, since you ask. And nobody's asked till now.
I've had {need} on my mind {time} and no time to see to it.
Everything aches and the work doesn't stop. That's the whole of it.
I'm well enough. Leave it.
My business.
And you'd be the picture of health, would you.
Look to your own face before you talk about mine.
That's kind of you, {speaker}. I'll not forget it.
Aye, well. It's the job. But thank you.
Hm. Thanks.
That's a lot of warm words from you, {speaker}. What is it you want?
You've been sweet all week. Nobody's that sweet for nothing.
Save it. I know what flattery sounds like.
Aye, that's about the size of me.
You've known me long enough to say it.
No. You've got me wrong there.
That's not how it went and you know it.
From you? That's rich.
No. It was {time}, and it was {memory}, not what you're saying.
You've the story crooked. Ask anyone who was at the {place}.
Near enough, but it was {qty} {item}, not what you said.
Best hand at {work} in this hall, and I'll say it to anyone.
Ask the {place}. My work stands where I left it.
{third}? Last I saw, at the {place}, and in no good temper.
I've heard the same about {third}. It'll be all over the hall by dark.
Good news for {third}, then. Somebody deserved a turn of it.
{third} keeps their own counsel. You'd have to ask them.
Aye, {third} means to do it. Said so at the {place}.
You're right about {third}. I've thought it {time}.
Aye. Everyone says the same and everyone's right.
No. {third}'s done nothing to earn that.
I'll not have that said about {third} in front of me.
You'd know all about talking behind a back, {speaker}.
We've been round {third} twice. What of the {place}?
Enough of that. Is the {item} seen to or not?
Then keep clear of the {place} till it's seen to.
Aye, and worse coming. Keep an axe where you can reach it.
Bad ground down there {time}. Don't go alone.
Aye. The whole hall's said it and nobody's mended it.
You're not wrong. It's been that way {time}.
You've been here five minutes. The {place} was always like that.
That's talk. I work it every day and it's sound.
Aye. Same as it was yesterday, and tomorrow after it.
The {place} stands. That's as much as anyone asks.
Long shift, {speaker}. Long shift.
There's worse places to be stood.
Prices are prices. Nobody's getting rich off it.
That {item} of yours has seen better days.
Good {item} is worth what it's worth.
Well enough. {work} and little else.
Poorly, since you ask. It's {injury}.
Tired to the bone. I want {need} and nothing more.
Still standing, {speaker}. That's the news from me.
Same as ever. {work}, and the hall's noise.
The {place}? Holding, for now. Wet, as always.
Two days' work left in it, no more.
Coal's low and the bellows want mending.
Quiet at the {place}, and I'll take quiet.
Something came to the gate {time}. It won't be the last.
{third}? At the {place}, last I looked.
You'd do better asking {third} yourself.
A good {item} goes for {price} gold, if you're buying.
I've {qty} {item}, and they're spoken for.
Take the {item}. You'll owe me nothing for it.
Aye.
No. Not today and not tomorrow.
Aye, and gladly, {speaker}.
No, and you'd know that if you'd been at the {place}.
Because {work} doesn't do itself and nobody else will touch it.
Because of {memory}, and that's all I'll say on it.
Because the {place} is the only thing keeping this hall fed.
I couldn't tell you. Nobody's said a word to me about it.
I don't know, {speaker}. I'd not guess at it either.
How would I know that? Ask somebody who was there.
No idea. I keep to the {place} and my own business.
That's beyond me. I dig, I don't reckon.
You'd know better than me. How is it?
Why ask me? What's it to you, {speaker}?
And yourself? You've been quiet {time}.
Say that again. My head's not right.
Slower. It's {injury} and I'm not following you.
What is it you're actually asking, {speaker}?
Ask somebody else, {speaker}.
Why would I tell you?
Find out yourself.
{speaker}! Sit yourself down.
Ah, {speaker}. A friendly beard for once.
Morning, {speaker}. Keeping well?
Aye, {speaker}. Morning.
{speaker}.
Aye.
Hm. You're up early for the {place}.
What is it you want, {speaker}?
Aye. {speaker}.
Later, {speaker}. Not now.
Not now, {speaker}.
I'm in no mood, {speaker}.
Ask me later. I'm not fit for talking.
Keep your voice down, {speaker}.
Aye -- quiet, now.
Not here. Not with what's about.
Aye. Go on, then.
Good. Go.
Well. Look what the {place} sent us.
Mind the ice, {speaker}.
Come back when the shift's done.
Aye. Mind how you go, {speaker}.
Right, {speaker}.
Aye. Off you go.
Good. Go.
That's decent of you, {speaker}. I'll remember it.
Kind of you to say. It's only {work}.
Aye. It was nothing.
Thanks for the word. I'd not have known.
Flattery's cheap, {speaker}. What is it you're after?
That's the third fine word this week. Out with it.
From you? Keep it.
Said and done, {speaker}. Let it lie.
Right. We'll leave it there.
Words, {speaker}. I'll believe the next part.
You'll need more than a word for that.
Aye. That was mine and I'm sorry for it.
You're right. {memory} was my doing. I'll put it straight.
Aye, I'll do it. Give me till the shift ends.
Done. {qty} {item}, and no charge to you.
Right. I'll see to it at the {place}.
Aye, go on then.
I'll do it. Once.
I'll do it for {price} gold. Not a coin under.
Bring me {qty} {item} first and we'll talk.
Half now, half when it's done. That's my price.
{price} gold, up front. I don't work on goodwill.
You'll pay for that, and you'll pay before I lift a hand.
Nothing's free out of this hall. {price} gold.
No. Ask somebody who owes you something.
Not for you. Not ever.
You don't give me orders. Get out.
No. I've {work} of my own.
Still no, {speaker}.
You asked me that already. The answer hasn't moved.
About that {item} you wanted. It's seen to.
That's twice now. Ask a third time and see what it earns you.
Aye, you said. I've not forgotten since {time}.
We've had this conversation, {speaker}.
Same question, same answer. Nothing's changed at the {place}.
You've said that three times now. I heard it the first time.
Aye, and you told me {time}. Twice.
Ha! From you I'll take it, {speaker}.
You're one to talk. Look at the state of your {item}.
Aye, aye. And your mother digs crooked.
That's your opinion, and it's worth what it cost.
Big words out of a small beard.
Say it closer, {speaker}.
You've said your piece. Now get.
I don't take that from you. I never did.
Take that back. Now, and in front of them.
You'll say sorry for that before either of us moves.
Try it and see where it leaves you.
Any time you like, {speaker}. Any time at all.
Come at me and it'll be {injury} you're nursing, not me.
Careful, {speaker}. That road only goes one way.
There's a hall full of witnesses. Think on it.
It wasn't me. I was at the {place} the whole time.
No. You've the wrong beard entirely.
It was {qty} {item} missing, not what you're claiming. Count again.
That happened {time}, and I wasn't there for it.
Funny. I was going to ask you the same about {memory}.
Look to {culprit} before you come looking at me.
You're quick to blame for somebody with your record.
It's {injury}, and nobody's lifted a finger about it.
I can barely stand. {injury} since {culprit} had at me.
I want {need} and a corner to sit in. That's all.
Every shift the same and {injury} for thanks.
Not now. It's {injury} and I've nothing left.
Fine words, and me with {injury}.
Easy. I've seen worse come out of the {place} and go away again.
It'll keep. Stand where I stand and it'll keep.
You're in no danger here, {speaker}. Sit.
Aye. Taken. I'll keep clear of it.
Right you are. That's the {place} for you.
I've heard your warnings before, {speaker}.
{memory}. I think on it more than I should, {time}.
We were better company once. Before {memory}.
The hall was fuller {time}. That's all I'll say.
This clan has buried better than either of us, {speaker}.
And there it is. I said it would come to this.
Good on {third}. Somebody had to have the luck.
{third}? Lucky once. It won't hold.
Hard on {third}. I'd not wish it on anyone.
If {third} wants a hand at the {place}, I've two.
I could eat the {item} and the plate under it.
Ha. If wishing filled a bin I'd be rich {time}.
Aye, and I'm the chief of this hall. Pull the other one.
Oh, very fine. You do talk well, {speaker}.
Sweetly said. Now say what you mean.
That was said with a crooked mouth, {speaker}.
I heard the edge on that, whatever the words were.
You don't mean a word of that and we both know it.
Eat first. Nothing gets better on an empty stomach.
Go to the {place} and rest it. That's my advice and it's free.
Enough of that. How's the {item} holding?
We'll not fix it talking. What's the {place} want doing?
There's not a better {item} in this hall, and I made it.
{qty} {item} out of the seam today. Beat that.
Aye. Thank you for that, {speaker}. It's more than most would.
I'll take it, and gladly.
Keep it. I want nothing from your hand.
I'd take {price} gold for it and call that fair.
You still owe me for {memory}. Settle that first.
Which is it? You've said two different things.
You're asking the wrong beard. I've no notion.
And what would you have done in my place?
Aye.
Hm. That's the way of it.
You don't say.
Nothing to say to that.
Mm.
Aye, {speaker}. You're about early.
Aye, true enough.
I'd not say that, myself.
Watch yourself. That's all I'll say.
That's hard. Truly.
Couldn't happen to a better beard.
Well. That's something worth hearing.
Say what's wanted and I'll see to it.
One more word and we're outside.
Say sorry. I'll wait.
You've a lot to say for a beard that took {qty} {item}.
Aye. I was wrong and I'll say so.
You're not worth the breath, {speaker}.
It'll pass. Most things do.
No. That's not how it went at all.
Nothing worth the telling. {work}, and that's it.
It's the {place}. Cold, loud, and ours.
That {item}? Worth about {price} gold on a good day.
No.
Because I said I would, and I keep to what I say.
Go on, then. I'll be here.
Aye, well. There it is.
Something like that, aye.
Right enough.
Never mind that. Have you eaten?
How would you have it, then?
Sell it while the price holds. It won't {time}.
{price} gold and the {item} is yours. Take it or don't.
Aye. Consider it done, {speaker}.
Orders, is it. From you.
And who's laughing now, {speaker}?
Anyone could have done that. I've done it {time}.
If that's the worst of your week, you're doing well.
{dwarf}, and I've been {dwarf} all my life. What of it?
They call me {dwarf}. I work {work} and keep out of trouble.
I want {goal}, and I'll have it before the year turns.
Because I want {goal}, and nothing else will get me it.
I want {goal} and I get {injury} instead.
Chase {goal} if you must, but not through the {place}.
